name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2502: v2500 added a reach assertion so a dead census source fails instead of passing quietly. A cold review of that mechanism found it scored each source by a delta rather than by what it holds - heart holds 46 names and the delta recorded 12 because 35 of them are the surfaces, so a healthy source could report zero purely because another ran first. Each source is now measured by its own filtered set and the pool is unchanged at 111. Blank names also counted as contribution and my first fix did not catch it - sabotaging the filter left the file green.
